title: LOS TOBAS, pasos básicos (Secundaria) - Recreado y adecuado para la edad.

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher guides students through structured steps with an energetic tone, frequently using props like a broomstick to represent dance spears. He breaks down movements systematically for beginners, emphasizing posture and rhythm.

lesson_structure.note: Warming up with full body movement, stretching, jumping, and jogging
Introduction to the class and dance background

metaphors: Símbolo de guerra, símbolo de lucha
safety: El calentamiento es importante para no tener problemas musculares

steps_taught.name: Paso de entrada
steps_taught.description: Basic stepping alternating feet with upper body posture

steps_taught.name: Salticado doble
steps_taught.description: Double skip step with slight torso and shoulder movements

steps_taught.name: Marcación básica
steps_taught.description: Three touches with the foot to one side then the other

steps_taught.name: Paso uno
steps_taught.description: Sequence combining skips and turns with a spear prop

what_works: Demonstrating differences between men and women's postures
what_hinders: Video angle switches between front and back views during instruction

quotes.text: El Tobas es una danza de género guerrero, así es que tenemos que bailar con fuerza.
Son ritmos básicos, son pisadas básicas.
Esto va a significar a la lanza.
El número cuatro... es porque es el tiempo muerto.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates basic weight transfer from right to left foot in place.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot pressure due to footwear and flooring

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates shoulder and arm movements holding a prop broomstick.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using a household broomstick as a prop to simulate traditional warrior spears during practice.
